title: Correction: zero temperature does not identify zero frequency dark matter
description: Audit metadata for the proposed inference, not a claim that this literal equation existed in a historical repository node. No matching historical node was found in the inspected scope; raw historical material is preserved.
equations: E_n = (n+1/2) hbar omega for the harmonic oscillator
assumptions: Harmonic oscillator formula assumes a defined oscillator with omega>0; omega->0 is a limit, not a normalizable bound oscillator at omega=0
confusion_guard: A zero-temperature ground state can have nonzero zero-point energy. Massive dark matter needs a separately identified energy contribution; it does not follow from the zero of hf.
